codeBoundary.sentence: The element becomes a field node, whose attributes are the governed static set schema v2 gave it and nothing else, so an attribute outside that set — or a value its closed grammar refuses — has nowhere to go. Widening the element-node attribute allowlist does not help: there is no element node here.

codeBoundary.population: an element node — every element that is not a link or image field
codeBoundary.sentence: The element keeps its tag and becomes an element node, which does have attributes, and this one is not on the allowlist or its value is not one the allowlist’s grammar accepts. Widening that allowlist is exactly what would help.
